weapons.name: MARS-H .308 Rifle
weapons.source_note: Specification table row: 'Rifling Twist Rate  1:10"'. The Details text states '13.5" 7.62x51 (.308) Light Weight Chrome Lined 1:10" RH Twist Barrel w/ Pinned LMT 3-Prong Flash Hider'. 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm. This is the 13.5 in MARS-H configuration; LMT lists 1:10 as the platform twist.

weapons.name: REPR 7.62 Rifle
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification block: 'CALIBER: 7.62 X 51 NATO', 'BARREL: 20", 16.1"', 'Cold hammer forged 1:10 twist stabilizes a wide range of bullet types'. 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm.

weapons.name: SMG-45 SMG
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification sheet: 'BARREL LENGTH: 8.5"           RIFLING: 1:16 RH/ 6 GROOVES'. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 6 grooves. The same sheet is published on the LWRCI product page as SMG45.pdf.

weapons.name: Baby Eagle III .45 Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: TWIST NOT STATED. The owner's manual technical data table gives only 'Rifling  6 Right Hand grooves, polygonal' for all calibers (including .45 ACP). Groove count and hand are cited but no turn length is published. Omitted per the no-guess rule; do not copy the corpus lead.

weapons.name: BFR .357 Mag Revolver
weapons.source_note: BFR Short Cylinder Models specification table, model column BFR357MAG, row 'Twist Rate  16' (with 'Groove Diameter  0.355'). 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, read from the rendered table image (page 32) because text extraction reorders columns. Note the earlier 5th Edition (2019) catalogue, before .357 Magnum was added to the BFR line, shows 26 for the .44 Magnum column.

weapons.name: BFR .44 Mag Revolver
weapons.source_note: BFR Short Cylinder Models specification table, model column BFR44MAG, row 'Twist Rate  26' (with 'Groove Diameter  0.430'). 1 turn in 26 in = 660.4 mm. Read from the rendered table image (page 30), which shows the table has no .357 Magnum column, so 26 unambiguously belongs to .44 Magnum. Confirmed identically in the 2021 7th Edition and 2025 11th Edition tables.

weapons.name: BFR .45-70 Revolver
weapons.source_note: BFR Long Cylinder Models specification table, model column BFR45-70 | BFR45-707, row 'Twist Rate  14' (with 'Groove Diameter  0.458'). 1 turn in 14 in = 355.6 mm. Read from the rendered table image (page 32); the 2019 5th Edition lists no .44 Magnum in the long-cylinder table, so 14 belongs to .45-70 Gov't.

weapons.name: BFR .500 S&W Revolver
weapons.source_note: BFR Long Cylinder Models specification table, model column BFR500SW10(B) | BFR500SW7(B), row 'Twist Rate  15' (with 'Groove Diameter  0.500'). 1 turn in 15 in = 381.0 mm. Read from the rendered table image (page 32); the model cell names the .500 S&W Magnum explicitly.

weapons.name: Desert Eagle Mark XIX Pistol
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer store specification table, .50 A.E. column: 'Polygonal Rifling w / Right Hand Twist, 6 lands & grooves | 1 turn in 19"; / 483 mm | 1 turn in 18"; / 457 mm | 1 turn in 14"; / 355 mm' for .50 A.E. | .44 MAGNUM | .357 MAGNUM respectively. The .50 AE value is 1 turn in 19 in = 483 mm, 6 lands and grooves. The 483.0 mm figure is the manufacturer's own stated value, not a conversion of a rounded inch figure.
